headline: Gold Slides to Over One-Year Low on Stronger Dollar and Rate Outlook
summary: Spot gold fell over 1% to its lowest level in more than a year, pressured by a firmer dollar and expectations of higher US interest rates ahead of Federal Reserve minutes.
why: Gold prices are highly sensitive to US real interest rates and the strength of the US dollar, serving as a primary safe-haven asset class globally.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: A stronger US dollar and expectations of higher interest rates reduce the appeal of non-yielding bullion.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A firmer US dollar and anticipation of further monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve diminished demand for non-yielding precious metals.
